issue:
Derived from L2 text (no argmap). ## kram-p20 (20)
Thus these three, by own-power-ray-mass-expansion, obtained, six-wheel-course-made, powers these; gradually by unfolding, varied world-state making; from these, goddesses, devoted heart, I be, fear-gone. // AgKs_20

premises.text: taditthaṃ te tisro nijavibhavavisphāraṇavaśād avāptāḥ ṣaṭcakrakramakṛtapadaṃ śaktaya imāḥ | kramād unmeṣeṇa pravidadhati citrāṃ bhavadaśām imābhyo devībhyaḥ pravaṇahṛdayaḥ syāṃ gatabhayaḥ
